title: Travel plan for the gift fair
ask: Write a short travel plan for the Melbourne Gift Fair. Take the dates from organiser-page.md, a copy of the organiser's page I saved this morning.
background: I'm counting on it being 14 to 16 May, because that is the week I booked off.
I'd fly down the night before and back the evening it closes.
Last year we stayed near the Exhibition Centre.
